title: AntLingAGI Makes No 2 Open Mobile Model Free on OpenCode
summary:
A total of 560B parameters and 25B active parameters per token now power an open-weights model hosted on the OpenCode platform. The Ling-3.1-flash assistant is available for free to users and lists a 262K context window on the hosting site, though the developer, AntLingAGI, had previously cited capabilities up to 1M tokens. The model is specifically optimized for healthcare, coding, and general productivity tasks.

The model ranks as the No. 2 open-weights assistant on the Design Arena's Mobile App Arena with a 1,207 Elo rating and No. 17 overall, performing close to GPT-5.6 sol and Opus 5 on core tests. It recorded 1,673 Elo on GDPVal-AA v2.1, 75.16 on FrontierSWE, and 65.35 on HealthBench Professional. AntLingAGI is operated by Ant Group, an Alibaba affiliate that runs Alipay and is a sibling to the Qwen model family.
